name: PAVE
description: PAVE is a large-scale benchmark consisting of 41k pedestrian-view images paired with accessibility-aware questions and depth-grounded answers. It measures grounded vision-language reasoning and segmentation performance for pedestrian navigation guidance, focusing on semantic and spatial understanding in urban scenes.
reputation: A specialized benchmark that is useful for pedestrian navigation and accessibility research, but it has not yet seen broad community adoption outside that niche.
notes: Focuses on depth-aware accessibility guidance with segmentation masks and conversational responses; includes a novel Region Alignment Loss.
